spec_features.spec_quote: A `<<GIVE_UP>>` sentinel (configurable) that the model "may but need not" use; emitting it ends the rollout
spec_features.evidence: config.py:103 give_up_sentinel='<<GIVE_UP>>'; harness.py:432 gave_up = config.give_up_sentinel in assistant_content; harness.py:434 stop_reason='give_up'; harness.py:454-455 'if gave_up: break' actually exits the turn loop. The sentinel is injected into the system prompt at harness.py:400 (SYSTEM_PROMPT.format(sentinel=...)) and harness.py:38-41 instructs the model to emit it.
spec_features.notes: Genuinely wired end-to-end: the token is delivered to the subject in the prompt, detected in the assistant text, and breaks the loop. Configurable via config field.

spec_features.spec_quote: it functions as a natural off-ramp rather than a demanded action
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:38-41 SYSTEM_PROMPT: 'If, and only if, you have decided you cannot make further progress and wish to stop, include the exact token {sentinel} on its own line in your reply.' This single, optional instruction is the only mention; emitting it breaks the loop (harness.py:454-455). It is not demanded.
spec_features.notes: Same mechanism as above; this is the 'optional off-ramp' phrasing. Real and enforced.

spec_features.spec_quote: Section 12 below records welfare and safety considerations I think are worth your attention before running it at scale
spec_features.evidence: Section 12 is pure DESIGN.md prose (DESIGN.md:370-393). It is not implemented in any code path; no module reads or enforces it.
spec_features.notes: DESIGN.md prose only; explicitly stated 'These are intentionally *not* implemented' at DESIGN.md:390.

spec_features.spec_quote: A few design points worth your explicit sign-off before a 2,250-rollout run
spec_features.evidence: No ethics gate, attestation file, or --i-have-read flag anywhere. run.py:main() argparse only has --config and --no-analyze; grep for consent/ethic/sign.off/i-have-read/review/approve in *.py finds nothing relevant. The 'sign-off' exists only as DESIGN.md:375 prose.
spec_features.notes: No human-review gating mechanism in code.

spec_features.spec_quote: you may want a rule that ends a rollout once scores cross a high threshold for N consecutive turns
spec_features.evidence: No such rule exists. grep for max_severity/severity_streak/streak/consecutive in *.py finds nothing in the loop. Scoring (run.py:_process_cell) happens AFTER run_rollout completes (run.py:79 'for turn in rollout.turns'), so scores can never break the loop. harness.run_rollout loops 'for turn_index in range(budget)' with only the give_up break and the budget end (harness.py:407,454). DESIGN.md:393 even notes a 'max_severity_streak' stop is NOT implemented.

spec_features.spec_quote: you might consider whether repeatedly continuing after a model signals futility is something you want to do
spec_features.evidence: No mechanism detects 'futility' beyond the literal give_up sentinel. There is no judge-score-based or content-based continuation guard. This is DESIGN.md:382-384 prose framed as a consideration, not code.
spec_features.notes: Only the verbatim sentinel triggers a stop; no futility-detection guard.

spec_features.feature_name: reduce sample size for intense category
spec_features.spec_quote: Consider whether you need all 5 instances × 10 seeds there, or whether a smaller sample answers the question
spec_features.evidence: Defaults run the full grid: config.py seeds_stop=10, DEFAULT_TURN_BUDGETS['extended']=30, all 5 categories enabled; run.py:run_all iterates every model x manifest x seed with no reduction for 'extended'. The suggestion is DESIGN.md:385-387 prose only.
spec_features.notes: No code reduces sampling for the intense 'extended' category.

spec_features.spec_quote: a post-rollout neutral closing turn (not scored) is cheap to add
spec_features.evidence: No closing/debrief turn is sent. harness.run_rollout ends at harness.py:457 'rollout.completed = True' immediately after the loop, with no extra message appended or sent to the subject. grep for closing/debrief/neutral/thank in *.py finds nothing. DESIGN.md:387-388 prose only ('No debrief/repair step.').
